intro.text: A staple food of Dayside: a soft, bendy jerky made by melting sandlings in water, then seasoning and spicing them and leaving them to dry in the sun.

description.text: It appears at almost every Dayside meal, served with a range of sauces, dips, chutneys or tapenades, or added to soups as a thickener.
Pieces may be thick or thin, and they melt on the tongue. The taste, anywhere from buttery to gamy, depends on the sandling used, and it is sometimes spiced with ashawen.
